name: gantry
description: A gated design -> plan -> build -> review pipeline for Claude Code. An interactive design author and four disciplined subagents turn a feature idea into reviewed, phased implementation that advances one gated step at a time, driven end to end by one orchestrator skill with both review gates. Two living docs (a currentness audit and a runtime verification queue) keep the project honest about what is real. Reads each project's own conventions, so it works in any stack.
